Description (in game): Jump abilities will be performed more quickly, and will be more powerful the more weight the user is carrying.
Notes: Damage is increased by 0.5% per point of weight. Speed increase seems moderate - it is less than the speed decrease from weight, but still gives a noticeable improvement compared to not having Momentum.

Description (in game): Any additional effects applied to regular attacks also apply to Jump. Also, there will be no stat reduction for wielding two weapons as long as a sword or spear is equipped in the left hand.
Notes: Affects that apply to regular attacks include Drain/Aspir attack, Mug, Indiscriminate Rage etc. Does not include damage bonuses from hit count.

Description (in game): Strike a single enemy with a powerful lightning-imbued physical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Draconics x13. Aim +15%, Evade +15%.

Description (in game): Jump up and out of the field of battle, then come crashing down next turn, performing a powerful physical attack on a target.
Notes:
Gives user the Jump status. The turn Jump is used, buff/debuff timers don't tick.
Jump status: User leaves combat, preventing them from being targeted or affected by anything. Next turn, gain no BP (even from abilities like True Grit) and they automatically use Jump as their only action. Jump status persists between consecutive battles.
Use action cost is for the duration between using Jump and landing. Landing cost is for the duration between landing and next having an action.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on all targets.
Perform a powerful lightning-imbued physical attack on a target.
Perform a powerful physical attack on an enemy that will heal an amount of the user's HP and MP based on the damage inflicted.
Notes: Restores 50% of damage dealt as HP and 5% of damage dealt as MP.

Description (in game): All status ailments will be automatically removed two turns after being inflicted, at which point HP and MP will be fully restored, and BP will be reduced by one.
Notes: Restoration happens at the start of the 2nd turn after receiving the ailment. Only 1 BP is spent, regardless of number of ailments removed.

Description (in game): Perform a powerful physical attack that can penetrate a target's Default defence.
Notes: Ignores Default

Description (in game): Performs Jump on a random enemy at zero cost as soon as battle begins.
Notes: Start battle in Jump state.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective on silenced targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 4x when striking silenced foes (4x normal damage)

Description (in game): All allies jump up and out of the field of battle, then come crashing down on their next turn, performing powerful physical attacks on random targets.
Notes: Gives all allies the Jump status. The user's buff/debuff timers don't tick for this turn.

Description (in game): Applying spells or other abilities to multiple targets will increase their effect, including the amount of damage inflicted.
Notes: Additive damage buff, which stacks with other additive buffs. Applies to healing, spells and physical attacks as long as they are AoE.

Description (in game): Perform a quick physical attack on a single target that has a good chance of removing one of their BP. (A critical hit is required to take BP to -2 or below.)
Spells or attacks affecting all enemies will inflict more damage the more BP the user has.
Notes: 10% more damage per BP. Note that this scales based on BP when you attack, not BP at the start of the turn. Moves that can be group cast benefit from this bonus as long as "all" targeting is selected, even if used against a single foe.

Description (in game): Spear aptitude is increased to S.
Perform an extremely powerful lightning-imbued physical attack on a target.
Jump up and out of the field of battle, then come crashing down next turn, performing a powerful physical attack on all targets.
Notes: Gives user the Jump status. The turn Jump is used, buff/debuff timers don't tick. When targeting all allies, does not hit self.

Description (in game): When spirits summoned by abilities are present, instant-death effects and status ailments that render their target inactive (sleep, paralysis, dread, berserk, confusion, charm, stop and freezing) are prevented, and as long as HP is at 20% or higher, the user can survive any attack with one HP.
Spirited Defence effects apply even when spirits are not present, and the effects of all spirit-summoning abilities learned so far are applied automatically when the user has one or fewer BP.
Notes: Spirits from There in Spirit don't count towards the one active spirit rule, any number of characters can have spirits up from this ability in addition to the one of your choice. This also allows you to have two copies of one spirit active. Note that There in Spirit activates Purebringer, which will periodically remove your buffs.

Description (in game): Greatly restore all allies' HP and apply Regenerate/Reraise effects.
Notes: Condition: Use Spirit Magic x12. M.Atk +15%.

Description (in game): Summon a spirit that will restore all allies' HP three times at regular intervals. Two spirits cannot be summoned at once. Summoning a new spirit will cause any existing spirit to disappear.
Notes: Spirit buff applies to self only, but its effect is AoE on team and uses AoE scaling modifier. Only one Spirit Buff can be active in the team at a time (outside of There in Spirit), if another is used by anyone, the first will be removed. Each is used three times, determined by the user's turn interval. Setting action cost is the duration until the user's next turn, recurring action cost is the duration (based on user's stats) between each activation of the spirit.

Description (in game): Perform a light magic attack on a target/all targets.
Restore a target's MP by an amount equal to 20% of the user's max. MP.
Restore 10% of a target's HP at the end of their turn. Effect will remain until actively removed.
Notes: Applies Regen status to target. When cast on Undead, strikes them with a light based attack with ability modifier of 4. Unlike the Cure line of spells, the power scales with your M.Atk and not Res Pow

Description (in game): Perform a powerful light magic attack on a target/all targets.
A selected ally will be automatically revived if knocked out. Effect will remain until target has been revived or effect is removed.
Notes: Applies Reraise status to target. When KO'd they revive with 200 HP (still counts as a KO and removes any buffs, debuffs and status ailments that KO clears)

Description (in game): Summon a spirit that will restore all allies' MP three times at regular intervals. Two spirits cannot be summoned at once. Summoning a new spirit will cause any existing spirit to disappear.
Notes: Restores 10% of each person's max MP each time it triggers. See Healthbringer for description of Spirit mechanics.

Description (in game): The first speciality listed for the user's sub-job is activated.
Notes: Specialties can only activate once, regardless of the number of ways they are activated (e.g. through Double Duty, SJS1/2 and the Spiritmaster/Bravebearer weapons)

Description (in game): Summon a spirit that will perform Basuna on all allies three times at regular intervals. Two spirits cannot be summoned at once. Summoning a new spirit will cause any existing spirit to disappear.
Notes: Removes poison, blindness, silence, sleep, paralysis, contagion, freezing and daubing. See Healthbringer for description of Spirit mechanics.

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful light magic attack on a target/all targets.

Summon a spirit that will remove status effects from all allies three times at regular intervals. Two spirits cannot be summoned at once. Summoning a new spirit will cause any existing spirit to disappear.
Notes: Removes most buffs and debuffs - appears to be identical to Purify/Square One except it does not remove Daub. See Healthbringer for description of Spirit mechanics

Description (in game): Perform an incredibly powerful light magic attack on a target.
Summon a spirit that will revive all allies three times at regular intervals. Two spirits cannot be summoned at once. Summoning a new spirit will cause any existing spirit to disappear.
Notes: See Healthbringer for description of Spirit mechanics

Description (in game): Staff aptitude is increased to S.
Summon a spirit that will restore a BP to all allies three times, at regular intervals. Two spirits cannot be summoned at once. Summoning a new spirit will cause any existing spirit to disappear.
Notes: See Healthbringer for description of Spirit mechanics

Description (in game): The more BP the user has, the more damage inflicted when regular attacks and swordmaster counterattacking abilities are performed.
Notes: 1 BP: +10%. 2 BP: +21%. 3 BP: +33%. 4 BP: +46%. Additive with other damage bonuses. Note that this depends on the users BP while attacking, not how much they had at the start of the turn.

Description (in game): Equipping the same type of weapon in both hands will activate sub-job specialities.
Notes: Specialties can only activate once, regardless of the number of ways they are activated (e.g. through Double Duty, SJS1/2 and the Spiritmaster/Bravebearer weapons)

Description (in game): Strike a single enemy with a powerful physical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Swordcraft x13. Spd +15%, Crit +15%.

Description (in game): Adopt a stance from which the 'Attack' command is automatically performed twice every time it is selected.
Adopt a counterattacking stance from which the user will automatically hit back against any attack aimed at them.
Notes: Activates whenever the user is attacked by a single target attack. Does not activate if user is inflicted with a status ailment that prevents choosing actions (Freezing, Sleep etc), or if the user takes no damage (e.g. due to immunity) or in response to another counterattack.

Description (in game): 50% chance of answering any physical attack with a counterattack. Will not be triggered by attacks that target the entire party.
Notes: Affected by luck. Activates whenever the user is attacked by a single target attack. Does not activate if user is inflicted with a status ailment that prevents choosing actions (Freezing, Sleep etc), or if the user takes no damage (e.g. due to immunity) or in response to another counterattack.

Description (in game): Usable when in Solid Stance. Perform a physical attack on a target that will delay their next turn.
Notes: Increases target action cooldown by 70

Description (in game): Usable when in Fluid Stance. When attacked, hit back with a physical strike that will reduce the opponent's BP by one. This will happen every time the user is attacked until their next turn, even if they have a negative number of BP.
Notes: Same activating rules as Fluid Stance/Counter. Can be set to activate multiple times in the same turn.

Description (in game): When the user is knocked unconscious, a hugely powerful physical attack will be unleashed on the perpetrator and their allies.
Notes: Will target whichever side killed the user. Reflected damage counts as being from the person casting the spell. Reprisal type damage will prevent the ability from activating, however. All buffs active when being killed will be active for the attack.

Description (in game): For four turns, the user will be targeted as frequently as their most frequently targeted ally.
Notes: Provides the "Divide Attention" buff, which apparently makes the user get targeted more often. I didn't really test much because it's hard to test.

Description (in game): Perform four physical attacks on a target in quick succession.
Notes: Total ability ratio of 5.15x

Description (in game): Equipping a sword, axe, spear or staff in the user's right hand will result in its being used with both hands, increasing its stats to 1.4x normal levels. The user's left hand must be empty.
Notes: Affects bonus to P.Atk, M.Atk and Res Pow only.

Description (in game): Usable when in Solid Stance. Perform a powerful physical attack on a target and bring the user's next turn around more quickly.
Notes: No explicit effect on making next turn quicker, it just has a low action cost.

Description (in game): Usable when in Fluid Stance. When attacked, hit back with a powerful physical strike that will increase the user's BP by one. This will happen every time the user is attacked until their next turn, even if they have a negative number of BP.
Notes: Same activating rules as Fluid Stance/Counter. Can be set to activate multiple times in the same turn.

Description (in game): 33% chance of any regular attack being followed up with a further quick physical attack.
Notes: Affected by luck. When combined with Indiscriminate Rage, every attack landed has a chance to activate Multitask, but the Multitask attacks will target random foes. Multitask attacks are NOT considered regular attacks in BDII.

Description (in game): Perform nine physical attacks on a target in quick succession.
Notes: Exact damage of each hit varies, in order: 1.3 + 1.2 + 1.1 + 1.3 + 1.5 + 1.4 + 1.5 + 1.6 + 1.8. Total ratio of 12.7x

Description (in game): Usable when in Solid Stance. Perform an extremely powerful physical attack on a target that will delay their turn, and also bring the user's next turn around more quickly.
Notes: Increases target action cooldown by 60. Like Solid Slash, it doesn't explicitly speed your next turn up - just has a low cooldown rate.

Description (in game): Usable when in Fluid Stance. When attacked, hit back with a powerful physical strike that will steal one of the target's BP. This will happen every time the user is attacked until their next turn, even if they have a negative number of BP.
Notes: Same activating rules as Fluid Stance/Counter. Can be set to activate multiple times in the same turn.

Description (in game): Attacks targeting elemental weaknesses deal 40% more damage, and elemental magic costs 40% less to perform.
Notes:
Cost reduction is additive with other cost reducing/increasing effects. Only affects elemental spells, non-elemental spells such as Meteor and Comet are not affected, and neither are magic damage effects which aren't spells such as Chiaro and Scuro.
Additional damage effect applies to all damage that hits an elemental weakness (including physical) and is an additive damage bonus.

Description (in game): Sub-job stat adjustments and weapon aptitudes are applied to the user's main job.
Notes: Completely replaces main job's stat and weapon ranks, even if/when they are lower.

Description (in game): Make all allies except oneself act sooner.
Notes: Condition: Use Divination x12. M.Atk +15%, M.Def +15%. Reduces all allies action cooldown, effect is usually big enough to get everyone to 0 or very close.

Description (in game): Enable an ally to deliver 50% more hits with the 'Attack' command for two turns.
Attempt to slow a target down.
Notes: Increases action costs by 50 for target

Description (in game): Make a target able to act more quickly for three turns.
Notes: Decreases action costs by 70 for target

Description (in game): Reduce a target's resistance to a selected element for two turns.
Notes: Counts as a status ailment for most purposes - has a chance of failing etc.

Description (in game): Perform up to three quick fire, water or lightning magic attacks on a target.
Notes: 1-3 hits randomly, with a 75% chance to continue after each hit. i.e. 4/16 chance of 1 hit, 3/16 chance of 2 hits, 9/16 chance of 3 hits, average ~2.31 hits per use, so total damage ratio on average is 5.78x. Each hit has a random element each time (same element can repeat). When group cast (e.g. with Across the Board), element is random per enemy but number of hits is fixed for whole group.

Description (in game): Imbue a target's regular attacks (performed with the 'Attack' command) and attacking abilities with a selected element for two turns.
Place a magic-reflecting barrier in front of a target for two turns.
Attempt to stop a target.
Notes: Stop lasts for as long as target would take to use a 500 action cost move (typically around ~2 actions)

Description (in game): Increase a target's resistance to a selected element for three turns.
When the user is knocked unconscious, any unconscious allies will be revived with full HP. One use per battle.
Notes: Effect triggers once per battle, per person with the skill.

Description (in game): Perform up to three fire, water or lightning magic attacks on a target in quick succession.
Notes: See Triple for details. Average damage ratio is 11.56x

Description (in game): Make a target act a lot more quickly for three turns.
Notes: Decreases action costs by 110 for target

Description (in game): Enable an ally to deliver 100% more hits with the 'Attack' command for two turns.
Attempt to slow a target down significantly.
Notes: Approx 80-90 increase to action cost for target

Description (in game): Perform up to three powerful fire, water or lightning magic attacks on a target in quick succession.
Notes: See Triple for details. Average damage ratio is 18.5x

Description (in game): One healing herb and one magic herb are received after every battle. Also, items will occasionally not be expended when used.
Notes: Estimated activation rate of around 30%

Description (in game): All item effects are increased when the user is empty-handed. Any effects earned from compounding will also be intensified, and the BP cost of all abilities will be reduced by one.
Notes: Bonus to item effect is additive with Healing Item Amp and similar. All effects are contingent on having nothing in either hand.

Description (in game): Strike all enemies with a physical attack that has a chance of inflicting poison, paralysis, blindness, silence and contagion.
Notes: Condition: Use Formulation x13. P.Atk +30%, Aim +30%.

Description (in game): Combine two items together for a range of interesting effects.
Notes: Huge variety of possible effects which I am not going to list here. Requires using one base ingredient out of your regular items (HP or MP restorative, Phoenix Down, status curing or attack item) and one additional ingredient out of your ingredient items. Affected by Across the Board.

Description (in game): Scrutinise all enemies closely, revealing their HP, vulnerabilities and family.
Notes: Info permanently revealed for all enemies

Description (in game): Use an item on multiple targets instead of one.
Notes: No reduction in effectiveness for item used.

Description (in game): Attempt to charm a target.
Revive a knocked-out target with 50% of their HP restored.
Notes: Attempts to inflicts Death on undead enemies.

Description (in game): Increases the chance of inflicting status ailments.
Notes: Increases status ailment chance. Includes things like casting revive spells on undead (which attempts Death). Does affect specials that inflict status ailments

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective on charmed targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 8x when striking silenced foes (3.2x normal damage)

Description (in game): Reduces damage received by 15% x the number of weapons equipped. Damage is reduced by a further 20% if the Highwind or Dual Wield passive abilities are in effect.
Notes: Additive damage reduction with things like Bard buffs, Angelic Ward etc.

Description (in game): Mix up a medicine that increases BP by one, and administer it to a target.
Mix up a medicine that reduces BP by one, and administer it to a target.
Notes: No limits, just reduces enemy BP by 1.

Description (in game): Perform a quick physical attack on a target that will reveal their vulnerabilities. For the next three turns, any attacks on monsters of that family will deal vulnerability-exploiting damage.
Notes: Gives the user a buff which enables effective damage against all monsters of that family (similar to elemental supplement with elemental weaknesses)

Description (in game): The effects of all healing items are increased by 50%.
Notes: Does not affect compounding/advanced compounding.

Description (in game): Combine three items together for a range of exciting effects.
Notes: Even huger variety of possible effects which I am not going to list here. Requires using one base ingredient out of your regular items (HP or MP restorative, Phoenix Down, status curing or attack item) and two additional ingredients out of your ingredient items. Affected by Across the Board.

Description (in game): Mix up a medicine that increases BP by two, and administer it to a target.
Make five copies of an item and administer them to a target at regular intervals.
Notes: Not affected by Across the Board
